baseHeatRule.contributors: players with at least 1 ceramic in the Shared Kiln or their Imperial Kiln

contributionCards.name: Bank the Fire
contributionCards.meaning: Deliberately restrain and bank the firing.
contributionCards.meaningZh: 压低本次烧成的基础火候。

contributionCards.name: Tend the Fire
contributionCards.meaning: Maintain the neutral fire without pushing it.
contributionCards.meaningZh: 维持平稳窑火，不作增减。

contributionCards.name: Stoke the Fire
contributionCards.meaning: Feed the kiln enough to raise the fire one step.
contributionCards.meaningZh: 添柴助火，使窑温上升一级。

contributionCards.name: −2 Bank
contributionCards.meaning: Fuel Ledger: bank the fire by two steps.
contributionCards.meaningZh: 柴簿：使基础火候降低两级。

contributionCards.name: +2 Stoke
contributionCards.meaning: Fuel Ledger: stoke the fire by two steps.
contributionCards.meaningZh: 柴簿：使基础火候提高两级。
